question: 请统计各地区的活跃用户数量及其平均订单价值，以便分析用户行为特征。
sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_users, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_active = true GROUP BY c.region;

validation_result.execution_result: 成功执行，返回了各地区的活跃用户数量及平均订单价值
